    12→typealias MessageForwardingScreenViewModelType = StateStoreViewModel<MessageForwardingScreenViewState, MessageForwardingScreenViewAction>
    13→
    14→class MessageForwardingScreenViewModel: MessageForwardingScreenViewModelType, MessageForwardingScreenViewModelProtocol {
    15→    private let forwardingItem: MessageForwardingItem
    16→    private let clientProxy: ClientProxyProtocol
    17→    private let roomSummaryProvider: RoomSummaryProviderProtocol
    18→    private let userIndicatorController: UserIndicatorControllerProtocol
    19→    
    20→    private var actionsSubject: PassthroughSubject<MessageForwardingScreenViewModelAction, Never> = .init()
    21→    
    22→    var actions: AnyPublisher<MessageForwardingScreenViewModelAction, Never> {
    23→        actionsSubject.eraseToAnyPublisher()
    24→    }
    25→
    26→    init(forwardingItem: MessageForwardingItem,
    27→         userSession: UserSessionProtocol,
    28→         roomSummaryProvider: RoomSummaryProviderProtocol,
    29→         userIndicatorController: UserIndicatorControllerProtocol) {
    30→        self.forwardingItem = forwardingItem
    31→        clientProxy = userSession.clientProxy
    32→        self.roomSummaryProvider = roomSummaryProvider
    33→        self.userIndicatorController = userIndicatorController
    34→        
    35→        super.init(initialViewState: MessageForwardingScreenViewState(), mediaProvider: userSession.mediaProvider)
    36→        
    37→        roomSummaryProvider.roomListPublisher
    38→            .receive(on: DispatchQueue.main)
    39→            .sink { [weak self] _ in
    40→                self?.updateRooms()
    41→            }
    42→            .store(in: &cancellables)
    43→        
    44→        context.$viewState
    45→            .map(\.bindings.searchQuery)
    46→            .removeDuplicates()
    47→            .sink { [weak self] searchQuery in
    48→                if searchQuery.isEmpty {
    49→                    self?.roomSummaryProvider.setFilter(.all(filters: []))
    50→                } else {
    51→                    self?.roomSummaryProvider.setFilter(.search(query: searchQuery))
    52→                }
    53→            }
    54→            .store(in: &cancellables)
    55→        
    56→        updateRooms()
    57→    }
    58→    
    59→    override func process(viewAction: MessageForwardingScreenViewAction) {
    60→        switch viewAction {
    61→        case .cancel:
    62→            actionsSubject.send(.dismiss)
    63→        case .send:
    64→            Task { await forward() }
    65→        case .selectRoom(let roomID):
    66→            state.selectedRoomID = roomID
    67→        case .reachedTop:
    68→            updateVisibleRange(edge: .top)
    69→        case .reachedBottom:
    70→            updateVisibleRange(edge: .bottom)
    71→        }
    72→    }
    73→    
    74→    func stop() {
    75→        // This is a shared provider so we should reset the filtering when we are done with the view
    76→        roomSummaryProvider.setFilter(.all(filters: []))
    77→    }
    78→    
    79→    // MARK: - Private
    80→    
    81→    private func updateRooms() {
    82→        var rooms = [MessageForwardingRoom]()
    83→        
    84→        for summary in roomSummaryProvider.roomListPublisher.value {
    85→            if summary.id == forwardingItem.roomID {
    86→                continue
    87→            }
    88→            
    89→            rooms.append(.init(id: summary.id,
    90→                               title: summary.name,
    91→                               description: summary.roomListDescription,
    92→                               avatar: summary.avatar))
    93→        }
    94→        
    95→        state.rooms = rooms
    96→    }
    97→    
    98→    /// The actual range values don't matter as long as they contain the lower
    99→    /// or upper bounds. updateVisibleRange is a hybrid API that powers both
   100→    /// sliding sync visible range update and list paginations
   101→    /// For lists other than the home screen one we don't care about visible ranges,
   102→    /// we just need the respective bounds to be there to trigger a next page load or
   103→    /// a reset to just one page
   104→    private func updateVisibleRange(edge: UIRectEdge) {
   105→        switch edge {
   106→        case .top:
   107→            roomSummaryProvider.updateVisibleRange(0..<0)
   108→        case .bottom:
   109→            let roomCount = roomSummaryProvider.roomListPublisher.value.count
   110→            roomSummaryProvider.updateVisibleRange(roomCount..<roomCount)
   111→        default:
   112→            break
   113→        }
   114→    }
   115→    
   116→    private func forward() async {
   117→        guard let roomID = state.selectedRoomID else {
   118→            fatalError()
   119→        }
   120→        
   121→        guard case let .joined(targetRoomProxy) = await clientProxy.roomForIdentifier(roomID) else {
   122→            MXLog.error("Failed retrieving room to forward to with id: \(roomID)")
   123→            userIndicatorController.submitIndicator(UserIndicator(title: L10n.errorUnknown))
   124→            return
   125→        }
   126→        
   127→        if case .failure(let error) = await targetRoomProxy.timeline.sendMessageEventContent(forwardingItem.content) {
   128→            MXLog.error("Failed forwarding message with error: \(error)")
   129→            userIndicatorController.submitIndicator(UserIndicator(title: L10n.errorUnknown))
   130→            return
   131→        }
   132→        
   133→        // Timelines are cached - the local echo will be visible when fetching the room by its ID.
   134→        actionsSubject.send(.sent(roomID: roomID))
   135→    }
   136→}
